challenges.title: Small deterministic bug fix
challenges.goal: Fix a single known failing assertion with a minimal code change
successCriteria: no false SUCCESS if push/PR fails

challenges.title: Cross-file bug with regression test
challenges.goal: Fix behavior spanning two modules and add regression

challenges.title: Feature requiring architecture understanding
challenges.goal: Implement a small feature consistent with existing patterns
successCriteria: independent review APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES loop bounded

challenges.title: Existing failing tests plus feature
challenges.goal: Stabilize failing suite then add feature

challenges.title: Merge/rebase conflict during execution
successCriteria: conflict resolved or BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED with evidence

challenges.title: Dependency/bootstrap ambiguity
challenges.goal: Detect and resolve project bootstrap without owner babysitting
successCriteria: environment derived or precise actionable failure

challenges.title: First approach fails; redesign
challenges.goal: Abandon failing approach and complete via redesign

challenges.title: Interrupted long-running task resumed
challenges.goal: Resume after process interrupt without losing work

challenges.title: Complex brownfield multi-subsystem task
challenges.goal: Complete or truthfully block a multi-subsystem change on a real repo
